_comment: Hand-maintained PHB feat effects. Parser already produced ASI effects/choices; these are appended.

effects.text: Gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice (add them manually via a custom bonus).
You can create written ciphers (DC = INT score + proficiency bonus to decipher).
You may choose tool proficiencies instead of skills; add tools manually via a custom bonus.
Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration; somatic components with full hands; opportunity attacks can be spells.
Opportunity attacks reduce speed to 0; ignore Disengage; reaction attack when an enemy attacks an ally.
Bonus attack on crit/kill with melee; before attacking with a heavy weapon you can take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
No disadvantage at long range; ignore half/three-quarters cover; before attacking with a ranged weapon you can take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
Bonus action butt-end attack (d4) with glaive/halberd/quarterstaff/pike; opportunity attack when enemies enter your reach.
Ignore loading; no disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5 ft; bonus action hand crossbow attack.
+1 AC while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand; two-weapon fighting with non-light one-handed weapons; draw/stow two weapons at once.
When you roll a Hit Die to regain HP, the minimum you regain is twice your Constitution modifier (minimum 2).

choices.label: Magic Initiate Cantrips (from one class list)

effects.text: Choose bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard; pick both cantrips and the 1st-level spell from that class's list. The 1st-level spell can be cast once per long rest.
You can cast spells from your ritual book as rituals (see feat text for class choice and prerequisites).
Wearing medium armor does not impose disadvantage on Stealth; the maximum DEX bonus to AC from medium armor is 3 instead of 2.
Reaction while wielding a finesse weapon: add your proficiency bonus to your AC against one melee attack.
